summary: This edition makes 8 reader-facing changes: 5 additions, 3 corrections. No guidance was removed.

items.title: Price the selected cache lifetime
items.whatChanged: Add selectable 12-hour cache lifetime, 2.5x write pricing and account/data-control checks.
items.why: Add the dated 12-hour option and 2.5x write-rate example after the cache-breakpoint guidance. Keep model-specific terms and data controls explicit.

items.title: Check service-tier policy before routing
items.whatChanged: Test organization/project service-tier restrictions and reject unauthorized fallback routes.
items.why: Add organization/project tier-policy checks to route compatibility and fallback decisions; a fallback must remain authorized.

items.title: Probe rubric artifacts in model judges
items.whatChanged: Add controlled answer/criterion counterfactuals and a rubric-only baseline.
items.why: Extend judge calibration with controlled semantic reversals and a rubric-only baseline where appropriate; keep claims bounded to the study.

items.section: Section 8: Speculative decoding and runtime migration
items.title: Verify speculative decoding policy
items.whatChanged: Separate lossless verification from opt-in lossy approximation and pin CUDA/framework/artifact compatibility.
items.why: Clarify that lossless speculative-decoding guidance does not cover an opt-in lossy verifier, and that serving-runtime upgrades require pinned CUDA/framework/artifact compatibility plus quality regression evidence.

items.title: Test monitor coverage and incident response
items.whatChanged: Inventory every agent/tool surface and test alert, external evidence, responder and containment behavior.
items.why: Add an explicit monitor-coverage inventory and test the complete alert, external-evidence, responder and containment path; monitor calibration alone does not prove a surface is covered or a response occurs.

sources.title: How we detect frontier model misalignment

items.title: Verify input availability at decision time
items.whatChanged: Require decision-time feature availability and deterministic provenance verification.
items.why: Add decision-time feature availability and provenance as evaluation invariants; a high offline score must not conceal a feature that cannot exist at the real decision point.

sources.title: LeakBench: Auditing Reward Hacking through Prediction-Time Leakage in Clinical Modeling Agents

items.section: Section 20: Tenant isolation and provider data policy
items.title: Check resolved request storage defaults
items.whatChanged: Verify the effective provider-side logging policy before routing sensitive requests. Google defaults storage on for new paid Generate Content projects from October 26. Existing projects keep their setting. Check the project control and request override using disposable inputs.
items.why: Test resolved provider project and request-level logging policy with synthetic data before adding sensitive inputs. A newly created replacement project can have a different default.

items.title: Record the current evidence review
items.whatChanged: Updated the evidence-review date and limited current-access assertions to sources reopened in this run.
items.why: Readers can distinguish the retrospective cutoff from the dates on which source text was checked.
